summary: Feedback batch-upload testing found unresolved acceptance defects despite clean approved non-browser checks. Passed commands: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `npm.cmd run lint`, and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\feedback-request-batch-upload-source.test.mjs` with 22/22 passing. Browser, Playwright, e2e, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email delivery were not run per task constraints.

defects.description: Duplicate required workbook headers are not rejected. Requirement FDB-VALID-004 requires missing, duplicate, or misspelled required headers to reject the file, but `src/features/feedback-request/validation.ts` builds `columnIndexes` with `new Map(header.map(...))` at lines 45-47 and only checks for missing columns. Duplicate headers are silently collapsed to the last occurrence.

Invalid calendar dates can be silently accepted. Requirement FDB-VALID-009 requires `purchase_date` parsing without silently accepting invalid calendar values, but `parsePurchaseDate` uses `new Date(isoLike)` at `src/features/feedback-request/validation.ts:132`; JavaScript normalizes impossible dates such as `2026-02-30` instead of rejecting them.

`product_code` and `product_name` are not bounded before persistence. Requirement FDB-VALID-010 requires trimmed and implementation-defined maximum lengths, but `src/features/feedback-request/validation.ts:72-87` only checks presence, then `src/features/feedback-request/service.ts:46-47` persists the values directly.

Uploaded file names are stored directly without sanitization or bounding. The requirements call out unsafe uploaded file names as needing sanitization or display-only safe handling; `src/app/dashboard/feedback-request/actions.ts:47` passes `file.name` directly as `sourceFileName` for persistence.
